Private history, increasing source exits and departure resources

Use Canonical definitions and the canonical foundation. Full journals and strict source boundaries are essential. This supplement gives the actual source maps; it does not treat counts as substitutes for cell witnesses.

Full-history source map and the corrected exit count

Fix any currently fresh old column ccc, not necessarily the rightmost one, and use its entire strict postbirth history

H={f(a,c):c<a<q},G={d(a):c<a<q}. H=\{f(a,c):c<a<q\},\qquad G=\{d(a):c<a<q\}. H={f(a,c):c<a<q},G={d(a):c<a<q}.

Survival means all these private awards are distinct, and seeds cannot reappear. The actual source-row map is a bijection H→{c+1,…,q−1}H\to\{c+1,\ldots,q-1\}H→{c+1,…,q−1}. Compose it with the injective diagonal map:

Φ(f(a,c))=d(a). \Phi(f(a,c))=d(a). Φ(f(a,c))=d(a).

It is a bijection H→GH\to GH→G and satisfies Φ(h)>h\Phi(h)>hΦ(h)>h, by strict row maximality. This is pointwise inflationarity, not order preservation between different inputs.

Every past diagonal has owner at most ccc or in (c,q)(c,q)(c,q); seeds of the first class are absent from HHH, so the nonpast history is exactly H∖GH\setminus GH∖G. Equal finite cardinalities give ∣H∖G∣=∣G∖H∣|H\setminus G|=|G\setminus H|∣H∖G∣=∣G∖H∣. In the directed graph h→Φ(h)h\to\Phi(h)h→Φ(h), every vertex has indegree/outdegree at most one and edges strictly increase numeric labels. Thus no cycle exists. Its paths pair exactly the roots H∖GH\setminus GH∖G with exits G∖HG\setminus HG∖H.

An exit zzz is also absent from the diagonal seeds by diagonal injectivity, hence from the whole journal. It is at most T<f(q,c)T< f(q,c)T<f(q,c), so positive MEX places it at a unique current host before ccc. It must have z>qz>qz>q: any cell at or below qqq is a death/frozen blocker, whereas zzz is diagonal. Thus it is a genuine pending old diagonal ghost. Different exits have different hosts. In particular ∣H∖G∣≤c|H\setminus G|\le c∣H∖G∣≤c; if a separately defined visible surplus P⊆HP\subseteq HP⊆H is also held before ccc, it is disjoint from the exits, so ∣H∖G∣+∣P∣≤c|H\setminus G|+|P|\le c∣H∖G∣+∣P∣≤c. This last statement requires that exact surplus definition.

Full-history no-return and exact relay hypotheses

For a full triangular history FFF, COPY/MEX uses V(t,c)={F(s,min⁡(s,c)):s<t}V(t,c)=\{F(s,\min(s,c)):s<t\}V(t,c)={F(s,min(s,c)):s<t} and strict current prefix. If F(s,c)=vF(s,c)=vF(s,c)=v and F(s+1,c)≠vF(s+1,c)\ne vF(s+1,c)=v, choose a least later return. COPY preserves the previous different value; MEX forbids the old vvv in VVV. Both contradict return. If v≤sv\le sv≤s is present at row sss, COPY preserves it on every later row.

If F(q−1,c)=v=F(q,d)F(q-1,c)=v=F(q,d)F(q−1,c)=v=F(q,d), d≠cd\ne cd=c, row injectivity makes the old/current hosts unique. The new host is MEX rather than COPY (including newborn d=qd=qd=q), and its whole blocker set omits vvv. Thus no earlier award in the existing part of that column had vvv. Also q≤vq\le vq≤v, since otherwise old host ccc would COPY vvv.

For a same-transition relay, require q≥3q\ge3q≥3, a root label xxx at strict old host b<q−2b<q-2b<q−2, absence of xxx from the new retained prefix, and an exact finite path of drop edges c→dc\to dc→d satisfying

d<c,F(q,c)=F(q−1,d). d<c,\qquad F(q,c)=F(q-1,d). d<c,F(q,c)=F(q−1,d).

It ends at a rising host with F(q,c)>F(q−1,c)F(q,c)>F(q-1,c)F(q,c)>F(q−1,c). Old-row injectivity makes outgoing drop edges deterministic; new-row injectivity gives indegree at most one. If two paths from distinct absent roots meet, backward tracing either makes the roots identical or places one root on the other's path. In the latter case that path emits the root's old label into the new retained prefix, contradicting its absence. Therefore their rising endpoints are distinct. This requires actual absent roots, not labels merely annotated as descendants of earlier roots.

Charge a certified original root (q,x)(q,x)(q,x) to its endpoint's old payload and column (y,c)(y,c)(y,c), where y=F(q−1,c)y=F(q-1,c)y=F(q−1,c), F(q,c)>yF(q,c)>yF(q,c)>y. Thus the charge is injective in one fixed history; different histories require a history identifier in the key.

The rise cannot be COPY, so y≥q≥3y\ge q\ge3y≥q≥3. Leftward relays starting at b<q−2b<q-2b<q−2 end at 0≤c≤q−3≤y−30\le c\le q-3\le y-30≤c≤q−3≤y−3. Consequently, for an arising endpoint payload y≥3y\ge3y≥3, at most y−2y-2y−2 roots are charged to that payload. For arbitrary y≥0y\ge0y≥0, the total bound is max⁡(0,y−2)\max(0,y-2)max(0,y−2), with no charged roots for y<3y<3y<3. This explicit domain repairs the literal unguarded y−2y-2y−2 wording. Relay existence, absent-root guards and earlier replacement absence remain premises.
